import math

MAX_STEER = 45  # degrees
REVERSE_SPEED = -0.8  # m/s (steady reverse)

def control(obs):
    # Hitch angle: positive = trailer swung left, negative = swung right

    # Steering toward the side the trailer is swung (follow it)
    steer = STEER_GAIN * hitch

    # Look toward the inner rail to monitor margin
    look = 60.0 if hitch > 0 else -60.0
    return {'steer_deg': steer, 'speed_mps': speed, 'look_deg': look}
